sourceFacts.statement: Actual entry is CLI dashboard terminal with input/output TTY and cursor-capable TERM checks, then tui.Run. Run owns the terminal and client connection only; exiting does not release leases or stop backend. Bubble Tea options use caller context/input/output and no signal handler; NO_COLOR selects ASCII profile. Real Run schedules native Init, closes actual sessions after program return and prints unresolved operation receipts. No entrypoint or terminal lifecycle is executed in this cut.

sourceFacts.statement: newDashboard is not a pure rendering constructor: it reads preferences under its supplied home and calls refreshPending/loadPending/openPending. openPending checks reset fence and directory identity, may create dashboard-pending and .lock, fsyncs and takes/releases a nonblocking flock. Actual Init batches native connect plus one-second clock. No fixture may call either with default/shared state.

sourceFacts.statement: Native connect opens the existing authenticated endpoint through client.OpenSession/ReadEndpoint/WebSocket. readSnapshot reads status with naming diagnostics, messages, agents and conditional lease_review_list. connect additionally subscribes to events/monitor and reads recent events; it does not itself start a backend. Reconnect commands may open the native client again. A synthetic render must suppress native Init/reconnect, not merely replace m.session after Init.

sourceFacts.statement: WindowSize clamps width to 1..500 and height to 1..200; model default is 100x30; its initially created65x20 viewport is resized/synced to96x20 at that default size, SoftWrap=true, textinput CharLimit=16384. One shared Bubbles viewport is resized/synced after Update. Update uses one wall-clock time.Now cut, with raw mouse ignored and click frame captured before advancing time. Rendering below 45x14 shows an enlargement notice, except fullscreen dispatch is checked first. Source formulas alone do not establish actual cell paint.

sourceFacts.statement: Shell has four top lines, bodyHeight=max(1,height-8) and four bottom lines. At width>=110 a 33-column feed and 2-column gap leave mainWidth=width-35; otherwise mainWidth=width. Nonmodal viewport is mainWidth-4 by bodyHeight-2. Modal width=min(mainWidth,88); its content is ANSI-wrapped at width-4, height=min(bodyHeight,max(9,wrappedLines+2)), centered over dimmed background with shadow. Detail/record/run detail are ordinary reading windows, not modal() surfaces.

sourceFacts.statement: Navigation labels expand at width>=100, abbreviate below100, compact further below55; inactive tab padding changes below65. Shell lines use fitBlock ANSI truncation and cell padding. align preserves a clipped right part and truncates left when needed; window bounds title to width-6. controlBar uses actual controls(), adds connected nonmodal Name first, and stops at the first action chip that will not fit; omitted later chips are not automatically wrapped. Scroll indicator is on the frame bottom, uses visual line counts and yields if too wide. These caps/omissions are policies to inspect, not diagnosed defects.

sourceFacts.statement: Keys route by actual state, not just view number: Ctrl+C exits first; name editor/fullscreen routing, q, node/recovery/editor/checkin/picker/review/composer routes precede ordinary record/detail/list logic. Numeric navigation resets selection/filter/feed, but lease detail handles numeric keys through its viewport fallback until closed; mouse nav explicitly clears detail/record first. Tab toggles feed focus; narrow f toggles compact feed and focus, while f in selected Runs means follow/pause. No universal key semantics are inferred across overlays.

sourceFacts.statement: Mouse is the actual tea.View.OnMouse path with cell-motion mode. View snapshots rendered frame hash, dimensions, current regions and a separate scroll-frame identity. Handler returns dashboardMouseMsg commands; raw mouse sent directly to Update is ignored. Native click acceptance invalidates changed geometry/modal/selection/content; wheel +/-3 tolerates scroll/telemetry changes but not navigation/context changes. Row and trusted action regions are derived from actual renderers/final review row; never infer actionable text from an arbitrary reason/log string. Source does not prove current hit-map/cell alignment.

sourceFacts.statement: Lease list preserves status order. Default hideInactive=true removes every state=terminal lease, independent of outcome; filtering matches full identity/display label/reason/state/status/agent/project/owner username. Table owns two row lines, source selection row=4+2*selected and matching two-line mouse regions. Columns use inner width mainWidth-4: 2 below58, reason added at58, claims/expiry at88. List names/reasons/account are bounded scan labels; details carry full ID/reason/claims/timestamps. No complete paint guarantee follows from that detail string.

sourceFacts.statement: Lease e/x/c build a draft review from connected/nonpending/exact current detail and eligibility guards. Renew edits bounded TTL from now; release/cancel bind revision and reviewed consumers, with consequence text for processes/storage/ports. n/Esc declines without a transport call; y in an eligible review is the lease_action mutation boundary and marks pending/unknown. Pending blocks repeat/close review; lost response stays unknown until fresh inspect, never auto-retried. Future inventory may render a draft and decline; no y or genuine lease_action.

sourceFacts.statement: Record reader JSON-marshals original typed value, rejects >4MiB, decodes with UseNumber, sorts object keys, expands independent JSON-encoded paths and pages children100 at a time. Tree has <=5000 rows plus an explicit display-limit notice, depth<=64 and indentation<=20 levels. Each scalar row is short(...,width), with quoted string representation; untruncated underlying value/numeric text does not mean full scalar glyphs are visible. Record is local reading state and has no transport call.

sourceFacts.statement: safe escapes Unicode controls/format/separator characters, spelling newline/carriage-return/tab visibly, and short applies ANSI-aware truncation. exact(json.Number) preserves its decimal string; byteCount formats a big.Rat in binary units rounded to one decimal. Owners prefer recorded username, or explicitly mark live current-account fallback when exact local host/UID match. Display names are metadata separate from action models. Existing escaping/value semantics must stay exact; raw ANSI/control bytes in a fixture log may only become inert visible text.

sourceFacts.statement: Runs currentRunRecord is state!=terminal OR outcome=reporter_lost; unfamiliar/interrupted states remain current even when not active. activeRunRecord covers active/queued/provisioning/ending/reclaiming/needs_attention. Stable ordering is active first, current before history, descending start/created, then exact ID. Status distinguishes reporter/log loss/unknown/cleanup/failed/completed. List uses compact two-line purpose/status and command/agent/age, full fields searchable; basename/path and whitespace shortening is intentional scan presentation. Source currentRunRecord is not a process-liveness proof.

sourceFacts.statement: Run reader uses original runsUI and shared viewport. readRunPage has 10s context, busy guard and exact captured session/UI generation; ops are runs inventory and run_output(id,byte offset). Visible/connected/session checks gate reads; retirement increments generation and cancels. accept requires same UI/generation/session, then visible/connected; pages require same run ID, exact offset and nextOffset=offset+len(data). Immediate following drains omit repeat inventory, periodic ticks refresh it. Roster ID/scroll anchoring is limited to runRosterVisible, excluding associated lease/detail/overlay contexts.

sourceFacts.statement: Displayed output retains latest256KiB and drops leading continuation bytes at cut, while exact durable offsets continue separately. safeRunOutput holds an unfinished final UTF-8 rune until complete if not done, replaces invalid UTF-8, expands tabs to4spaces, escapes controls and injects display newlines every512runes before Bubbles soft-wrap. Source caps are not full retained-log acceptance or a visual defect. Reporter-lost/truncation/display-cut/disconnected/error text remain distinct.

sourceFacts.statement: Selected run detail shows complete source command/reason/CWD/IDs and honest missing timestamps; Local marker requires exact known32hex host match, not cosmetic name. f/End follows, scroll keys pause, Home resets display cursor and reads from0 paused, n pages only paused/notdone, r refreshes, l opens exact associated lease, i builds original local record. Fold is presentation only, capture/follow can continue. z enters full-terminal same-buffer viewport (width x height-2), saves prior fold/offset, and Esc restores prior reader state before returning to roster. Navigation/exit retires reader; fullscreen itself does not create another reader.

At each grid: one long lease detail and original local record; first/middle/final reach samples keep allocation, safe value and truncation semantics separate
